1.1 Purpose
The purpose of this document is to describe the System Requirement Specification, including the functional requirements and non-functional requirements of Mercedes Benz CMS project CMS028-A1.
The System Requirement Specification is distributing from the Stakeholder Requirement.
The System Requirement Specification is input for the further system development like System Architecture Design.

2.1.2 Product Description
FDM is mainly responsible for the basic functions of the streaming rearview mirror in the GMSL2 coaxial video transmission architecture. This includes, but is not limited to: high-definition camera ima

al video transmission architecture. This includes, but is not limited to: high-definition camera image display, angle adjustment, image zoom adjustment, image storage, anti-glare control, automatic backlight adjustment of the screen, backlight adjustment of the screen, fault indication, and other non-functional requirements related to vehicle access for diagnostics/configuration/production satisfaction.
